title: REQ · BootScene preload and build test callbacks have explicit types
summary: Remove implicit any in BootScene.preload and bootSceneBuild test
description: Context: BootScene.ts line 42 (manifest.assets.find callback 'a') and bootSceneBuild.test.ts line 138 (flatMap callback 'o') have implicit any. Desired behavior: both parameters carry explicit types. Expected result: no TS7006 at those lines.
acceptance_criteria: Given BootScene.preload, when tsc runs, then the 'a' parameter has an explicit type and no TS7006 is reported
Given bootSceneBuild.test.ts, when tsc runs, then the 'o' parameter is typed and the suite passes with buildScene receiving the mocked sceneSpec
technical_constraints: Use types already exported from @game/assets/manifest or the content module; do not invent new ones
